verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a fully managed service. Its docs say it runs on Twitch's global infrastructure, automatically ingests video at a location near the broadcaster, and can serve audiences beyond 25,000 viewers, so managed scaling across regions is implied. The evidence contains only short marketing-level statements, not documentation of how the media layer actually scales. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the autoscaling or multi-region distribution architecture, documented scaling limits and quotas per region, failover/redundancy behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scaling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering

citations.quote: Use the same live streaming technology and global infrastructure that powers Twitch.
When you stream, Amazon IVS automatically ingests video at a location near you.
Accommodate audiences beyond 25,000 viewers and enable up to 12 hosts to take the virtual stage.
With Amazon IVS, you can stream without needing to manage or develop components on your own.
